cpp/tests/regional_interaction_service_report_interaction_catch2.cpp::Embedded service reporting delivers accepted regional Send Interaction With Regions through MOM interaction
requirements.notes: The standalone C++ HLA_EVOKED case configures a real joined-federate filesystem, keeps reporting disabled during setup, and then records one accepted overlap-qualified ordinary regional Send Interaction With Regions invocation before the constrained Receive Interaction callback. It verifies service type 2, type-27/type-40/type-43/type-63/type-34 supplied forms, the type-34 Null returned argument, serial zero, source RegionHandleSet conveyance, payload, producer, and tag. It remains non-installable development-profile traceability; public MOM routing, failure families, timestamped/re-enable/save/restore, transport, JUnit/protected review, Lab validation, and conformance are separate lanes.

tests: cpp/tests/regional_interaction_service_report_interaction_catch2.cpp::Embedded service reporting delivers accepted regional Send Interaction With Regions through MOM interaction
requirements.notes: The standalone C++ HLA_IMMEDIATE observer subscribes to HLAreportServiceInvocation while the publisher keeps file reporting disabled. One accepted overlap-qualified ordinary regional Send Interaction With Regions invocation is delivered as a MOM interaction during the service call, before the receiver's HLA_EVOKED application callback. The case verifies service type 2, serial zero, success, exact Table 5 type-27/type-40/type-43/type-63/type-34 supplied forms, the type-34 Null return, empty exception, source RegionHandleSet conveyance, payload, producer, and tag. It remains non-installable development-profile traceability; filesystem lifecycle, failure families, timestamped/remote transport, Lab validation, and conformance remain separate.
